PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Dr. Rawi Elamin

Public Health Epidemiologist · Global Health Security Specialist

Public health epidemiologist and global health security specialist with 16 years of experience supporting WHO, IFRC, IOM and national Ministries of Health across Africa, the Middle East, Asia-Pacific and Europe. His CV focuses on infectious-disease surveillance, emergency preparedness, outbreak response and International Health Regulations (2005) implementation.

CAREER HISTORY

Professional experience.

May–October 2025Manila, Philippines

Technical Officer, Disaster Risk Reduction

WHO Western Pacific Regional Office (WPRO)

  • Led multi-hazard risk profiling and workforce mapping across four countries.
  • Developed a regional assessment tool for hospital and health-infrastructure readiness.
  • Created a regional training package on risk profiling and workforce mapping.
September 2020–November 2024Belgrade, Serbia

Technical Officer, Emergency Preparedness & Response / Epidemiologist

WHO Regional Office for Europe, Balkan Health Emergencies Hub

  • Led regional epidemiological surveillance and preparedness initiatives across seven Balkan countries and areas through two consecutive WHO assignments.
  • Managed COVID-19 case notification, contact tracing, line lists and reporting to WHO and national Ministries of Health.
  • Supported WHO and ECDC reporting through TESSy and EUROflu.
  • Deployed Go.Data in Moldova, Kosovo and Bosnia and Herzegovina and developed Kosovo's national COVID-19 epidemiological dashboard.
  • Coordinated seroepidemiological and vaccine-effectiveness studies in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo and North Macedonia.
  • Delivered 22 sub-regional training activities and wrote PHEOC standard operating procedures for North Macedonia, Albania and Kosovo.
  • Coordinated response reviews in four countries and deployed to Yemen in 2024 for national risk profiling and a cholera intra-action review.
June–August 2020Banjul, The Gambia

Senior Technical Officer, Epidemic Preparedness

Resolve to Save Lives — Strategic Hub for Accelerated Response and Preparedness (SHARP)

  • Led the national epidemic-preparedness programme during COVID-19 across surveillance, laboratories, emergency operations, risk communication, workforce and legal frameworks.
  • Mobilised more than USD 500,000 in emergency funding.
  • Advised the national COVID-19 Task Force and supported legal reforms aligned with international standards.
February 2017–May 2020Sudan, Cambodia, Ethiopia, Malawi & Republic of the Congo

Epidemiologist & Emergency Preparedness Officer — multiple field assignments

World Health Organization, Health Emergencies Programme

  • Served as COVID-19 Epidemiologist in Sudan; Health Emergencies Officer in Cambodia; Epidemiologist and Sub-national Health Cluster Coordinator in Ethiopia and Malawi; Technical Officer for Event-Based Surveillance at WHO AFRO; and Epidemiologist for Emergency Humanitarian Action in Sudan.
  • Conducted more than 20 rapid risk assessments spanning 47 African countries.
  • Led emergency-response operations for flood, conflict and epidemic events across four countries.
  • Strengthened incident-management teams, rapid-response teams, early-warning systems and IDSR systems.

IFRC in Sierra Leone / IOM in Liberia

Ministry of Health, Khartoum State
